name: spatial-elements
description: A framework for spatial immersive content experiences.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @spatial-elements/core && npm run build -w @spatial-elements/sveltekit
scripts.check: npm run build -w @spatial-elements/core && npm run check --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n core,sveltekit "npm run dev -w @spatial-elements/core" "npm run dev -w @spatial-elements/sveltekit"
scripts.verify: npm run check:boundaries && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:packages
scripts.demo: npm run build && node scripts/sync-demo-assets.mjs && npm run dev -w @spatial-elements/demo-sveltekit
